title: 🧬 Foundation Layer: Seed the Cognitive Kernel
body:
### Problem Identification
The cognitive kernel requires a solid foundation: `cogutil` and `moses`.

### Subsystem Mapping
- **Memory**: Build artifacts for downstream jobs
- **Task**: CMake configuration, real test execution
- **AI**: ggml kernel adaptation (tensor shape: `[modules, build-steps, tests]`)
- **Autonomy**: Hardware matrix for architectures

### Actionable Steps
- [ ] Define build/test scripts for `cogutil` and `moses`
- [ ] Parameterize for ggml tensorization
- [ ] Insert hardware matrix if desired
- [ ] Output artifacts for downstream jobs
- [ ] Document tensor DOF (degrees of freedom) per module

### Theatrical Finale
Let the kernel awaken — prime factors aligned!
